activity_summary: Field stopped at the foot of the stair and took the Italian book back. He let you reach a second clause and then asked whether the thing was written, rumoured, or known. You said you feared it. He left the Holinshed lent. Mistress Ansell heard it from the hall. It took about a minute.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Feared the thing, and gave the book over with no title.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Asked the question, took the book, and left the Holinshed lent.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Heard it from the hall, and said he was the friend who leaves fastest.

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: Is this a thing written, a thing rumoured, or a thing thou knowest?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is a thing I fear

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: And my Holinshed is neither written, rumoured nor known, but lent.
